scenes.title: Llama Slips on Ice
scenes.caption: After a title card over a blue sky, a llama slides and flails across a frozen puddle in a snowy mountain field near a wire fence, then ends up sprawled flat on the ice beside a small plant with red berries.

scenes.title: Penguin and llama on tracks
scenes.caption: A small gray and white penguin stands in the snow beside a llama lying on its side, then appears tiny between railroad tracks with a small green plant bearing a red bud.

scenes.title: Penguin Peeks Over Ridge
scenes.caption: In a snowy landscape, the wide-eyed llama turns toward the camera with a startled expression, and a small penguin peeks up over a misty ridge in the distance.

scenes.title: Llama's Underground Mine Ride
scenes.caption: A llama wearing a round goggle-like headpiece looks around in a snowy landscape, then appears upside down in a dark, blue underwater-like cave, and finally rides a wooden mine cart along a rickety track with a small white bird and a red flower beside it.

scenes.title: Mine Cart Berries
scenes.caption: A mine track runs down a dark, broken cavern, then a tan animal with heavy-lidded eyes sits in a wooden cart beside a small black-and-white penguin-like bird, with a pile of red berries between them in a snowy setting.

scenes.title: Airborne Over Mountains
scenes.caption: The llama and a small white penguin tumble and float through the air high above snowy mountains and clouds, with the llama's eyes wide and its mouth open in surprise.

scenes.title: Tumbling Down Snow
scenes.caption: A wide-eyed, orange-brown animal with a long neck appears against a backdrop of clouds, then rolls down a snowy slope in a ball past jagged rocky peaks and ends up sprawled flat on its belly in the snow.

scenes.title: Llama's Clifftop Gaze
scenes.caption: The animated llama faces the camera in a snowy mountain landscape, its large eyes shifting from wide open to heavy-lidded and squinting, then the view cuts to a wide shot of the llama standing at the edge of a snowy cliff above the ocean, with a striped lighthouse nearby.

scenes.title: Penguin's Berry Gift
scenes.caption: In a snowy landscape, a small penguin holds out a bunch of red berries to the llama, then the llama lies in the snow among a crowd of penguins and an offering of berries, fish and lanterns, before the film's credits appear over a starry sky.
